key.name: enabled
key.description: Lets the scale keys of org.mate.polo.keybindings and the scale hot corner actions spread out windows to pick one.

key.name: screens
key.description: "summoned": only the screen under the pointer, or the hot corner's screen; summoned-windows decides which windows it shows. "each": every screen shows the windows on it. "mirrored": every screen shows every window.

key.name: summoned-windows
key.summary: Windows shown on the summoned screen
key.description: With screens "summoned": "this-screen" shows only the windows on that screen, "every-screen" gathers the windows of every screen there.

key.name: mode-screens
key.description: Overrides screens for the modes named: "workspace", "all-workspaces", "application" and "application-all-workspaces", for example {'all-workspaces': 'summoned'}.

key.name: layout
key.description: "natural": windows stay near where they are, pushed apart until none overlap. "grid": rows of windows, most recently used first.

key.name: all-workspaces-layout
key.description: "grouped": one band per workspace, with its name. "mixed": all windows together.

key.name: spacing
key.description: Pixels kept between windows and around them.

key.name: duration-ms
key.description: Milliseconds Scale takes to open and to close.

key.name: minimized
key.description: Whether Scale shows minimized windows ("show"), shows them half transparent ("dimmed"), or leaves them out ("hide").

key.name: window-titles
key.description: Shows each window's title on it.

key.name: background
key.description: What Scale shows behind the windows: a solid dark grey ("solid"), the desktop background ("wallpaper"), or the desktop background blurred ("blurred-wallpaper").

key.name: background-blur
key.description: How far, in pixels, the "blurred-wallpaper" background is blurred.

key.name: background-dim
key.description: How much darker the wallpaper behind Scale is drawn, from 0 (as is) to 1 (black).

key.name: other-workspace
key.summary: Picking a window on another workspace
key.description: "switch": go to the window's workspace. "bring": move the window to the current workspace.

key.name: empty-click
key.description: What a click where there is no window does: close Scale ("close"), or close it and show the desktop ("show-desktop").

key.name: middle-click
key.description: "close-window" asks the window to close; "none" does nothing.

key.name: hold
key.description: When true, Scale opened with a key stays open only while that key's modifier is held, and letting go of it picks the selected window, as Alt+Tab does.

key.name: scale
key.summary: Scale the windows of this workspace
key.description: Spreads out the windows of the current workspace to pick one, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none). Pressing it again closes Scale.

key.name: scale-all-workspaces
key.summary: Scale the windows of every workspace
key.description: Spreads out the windows of every workspace to pick one, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none).

key.name: scale-application
key.summary: Scale the windows of the focused application
key.description: Spreads out the windows of the focused window's application on the current workspace, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none).

key.name: scale-application-all-workspaces
key.summary: Scale the windows of the focused application on every workspace
key.description: Spreads out the windows of the focused window's application on every workspace, in Marco's accelerator syntax ("disabled" for none).
